reason: A conversation-page Prompt Studio for editing, ordering, previewing, and applying prompt components while inspecting injected runtime context; it also supports controlled workspace-context file edits.

summaries.zh: 在对话页面编辑、排序、覆盖并预览系统提示词和消息补充，同时查看运行时注入的上下文。
summaries.en: A conversation-page studio for editing, ordering, overriding, and previewing prompt components while inspecting injected runtime context.

capabilities: Edits and persists user-defined system, user, and assistant prompt components
Overrides or disables runtime-native prompt components
Displays assembled system prompts and message placement previews
Captures injected non-conversation context from model requests
Reads and writes workspace-context resource files with version conflict detection
Provides a local prompt state HTTP endpoint for the browser interface
